summary: Validated tablet delivery-fee waiver end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_tablet_delivery_waiver.py — (a) POST /api/tablet/quote (delivery, valid tablet auth) returns delivery_fee=0, tablet_delivery_waived=true, total==subtotal, and no order fields; (b) POST /api/tablet/quote without auth is 401/403; (c) POST /api/checkout/quote for the equivalent public delivery payload uses normal delivery-fee rules with tablet_delivery_waived=false; (d) same items yield same subtotal in both quotes; (e) tablet pickup quote keeps tablet_delivery_waived=false and fee=0; (f) tablet quote with an active free_delivery coupon does NOT consume it (verified used_count=0 in /api/admin/coupons after quote) and does NOT set coupon_code/discount on the response — the waiver short-circuits _apply_coupon (server.py L910-913); (g,h) static-source assertions confirm immediate tablet orders push copies=3 via _push_print_job_background and the scheduled branch returns {print_queued:false} BEFORE any push. Frontend: /tablet at 390px — logged in as tablet@burgertimes.fr, added 'Mozza Sticks (x8)' (8.00 €) from Sides, switched to Livraison; [data-testid=tablet-delivery-fee-waived] renders 'Livraison tablette' + 'Offerte' in green (#3DDC97); regular 'Livraison' fee row hidden; [data-testid=tablet-order-total] shows 'Total 8.00 €' (== subtotal); documentElement.scrollWidth == 390 (no horizontal overflow). Submit was NOT clicked; no /api/tablet/orders POST issued; no kitchen action fired; no physical print triggered.

issues: Purely cosmetic: the two <span>s inside [data-testid=tablet-delivery-fee-waived] have no separator so text nodes concatenate to 'Livraison tabletteOfferte' in innerText (they are visually separated by justify-between so the on-screen appearance matches the spec 'Livraison tablette — Offerte'). Non-blocking; consider adding an em-dash for screen readers if desired.

critical_code_review_comments: _quote_or_create (server.py L910-913): tablet_delivery_waived = order_source=='tablet' AND fulfillment=='delivery' — evaluated once and (a) zeros delivery_fee, (b) SKIPS the _apply_coupon branch via `elif payload.coupon_code:`. Since coupon consumption only happens inside _apply_coupon when create=True (server.py L831), and _apply_coupon is never called on the tablet-waiver path, coupons cannot be consumed by tablet quote OR by tablet order creation with a coupon_code — good, matches spec that coupon consumption stays unchanged (it happens only via public /checkout/session).

tablet_delivery_waived is always emitted in the quote response (True or False) — makes it easy for both public /checkout/quote consumers (always False) and tablet UI (True on delivery) to branch safely.
Public /api/checkout/quote correctly omits order_source, defaulting to 'web' → waiver never triggers on public path. Verified live.

TabletOrder.jsx L593-601: waived row is gated on `fulfillment==='delivery' && quote?.tablet_delivery_waived` — matches server flag; regular fee row (L587) is gated on `quote?.delivery_fee > 0` so it stays hidden when fee is 0.

Static contract: server.py contains `_push_print_job_background(order_id, accepted, copies=3)` for immediate tablet orders and the scheduled branch returns `"print_queued": False` before that line — confirms tablet immediate = 3 copies, scheduled tablet = 0 copies (unchanged from iteration_33 spec).
